# AG Grid Documentation

> AG Grid is a high-performance, feature-rich JavaScript data grid component supporting React, Angular, Vue, and vanilla JavaScript. Available as Community (MIT licensed) and Enterprise (commercial) versions.

## Project Overview

AG Grid provides:
- Virtual DOM rendering for high performance with large datasets
- Column-based configuration with sorting, filtering, editing, and custom rendering
- Multiple row models: Client-Side, Server-Side, Infinite, and Viewport
- Enterprise features: Row Grouping, Pivoting, Aggregation, Tree Data, Master/Detail, Excel Export, Integrated Charts, Sparklines
- Framework-specific wrappers for React, Angular, and Vue 3
- Modular architecture for bundle size optimization

## Installation

```bash
# React
npm install ag-grid-react

# Angular
npm install ag-grid-angular

# Vue 3
npm install ag-grid-vue3

# Vanilla JavaScript
npm install ag-grid-community

# Enterprise features
npm install ag-grid-enterprise
```

## Module Registration

AG Grid requires module registration for NPM installations. Use bundles for all features or cherry-pick modules for smaller bundles.

```javascript
// Bundle approach - all Community features
import { AllCommunityModule, ModuleRegistry } from 'ag-grid-community';
ModuleRegistry.registerModules([AllCommunityModule]);

// Bundle approach - all Community + Enterprise features
import { AllEnterpriseModule } from 'ag-grid-enterprise';
ModuleRegistry.registerModules([AllEnterpriseModule]);

// Individual modules for bundle optimization
import { ClientSideRowModelModule, CsvExportModule } from 'ag-grid-community';
import { SetFilterModule, ExcelExportModule } from 'ag-grid-enterprise';
ModuleRegistry.registerModules([
    ClientSideRowModelModule,
    CsvExportModule,
    SetFilterModule,
    ExcelExportModule
]);
```

React uses `AgGridProvider` for module injection:
```jsx
import { AllCommunityModule } from 'ag-grid-community';
import { AgGridProvider, AgGridReact } from 'ag-grid-react';

const modules = [AllCommunityModule];
function App() {
    return (
        <AgGridProvider modules={modules}>
            <AgGridReact rowData={rowData} columnDefs={columnDefs} />
        </AgGridProvider>
    );
}
```

## Basic Grid Configuration

### JavaScript
```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    rowData: [
        { make: "Tesla", model: "Model Y", price: 64950 },
        { make: "Ford", model: "F-Series", price: 33850 }
    ],
    columnDefs: [
        { field: "make" },
        { field: "model" },
        { field: "price" }
    ]
};

const gridElement = document.querySelector('#myGrid');
agGrid.createGrid(gridElement, gridOptions);
```

### React
```jsx
import { AgGridReact } from 'ag-grid-react';
import { useState } from 'react';

const GridExample = () => {
    const [rowData, setRowData] = useState([
        { make: "Tesla", model: "Model Y", price: 64950 }
    ]);
    const [columnDefs, setColumnDefs] = useState([
        { field: "make" },
        { field: "model" },
        { field: "price" }
    ]);

    return (
        <div style={{ height: 500 }}>
            <AgGridReact rowData={rowData} columnDefs={columnDefs} />
        </div>
    );
};
```

### Angular
```typescript
import { AgGridAngular } from 'ag-grid-angular';
import type { ColDef } from 'ag-grid-community';

@Component({
    selector: 'app-root',
    standalone: true,
    imports: [AgGridAngular],
    template: `
        <ag-grid-angular
            [rowData]="rowData"
            [columnDefs]="colDefs"
            style="height: 500px"
        />
    `
})
export class AppComponent {
    rowData = [{ make: "Tesla", model: "Model Y", price: 64950 }];
    colDefs: ColDef[] = [{ field: "make" }, { field: "model" }, { field: "price" }];
}
```

### Vue 3
```vue
<template>
    <ag-grid-vue
        :rowData="rowData"
        :columnDefs="colDefs"
        style="height: 500px"
    />
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AgGridVue } from "ag-grid-vue3";

const rowData = ref([{ make: "Tesla", model: "Model Y", price: 64950 }]);
const colDefs = ref([{ field: "make" }, { field: "model" }, { field: "price" }]);
</script>
```

## Column Definitions

Columns are defined via `columnDefs` array. Each column has properties controlling sorting, filtering, editing, rendering, and more.

```javascript
const columnDefs = [
    // Basic column
    { field: 'athlete' },

    // Custom header name
    { field: 'age', headerName: 'Age (years)' },

    // With sorting and filtering
    { field: 'country', sortable: true, filter: true },

    // With editing
    { field: 'sport', editable: true },

    // With custom cell renderer
    { field: 'price', cellRenderer: params => `$${params.value}` },

    // Pinned column
    { field: 'id', pinned: 'left' },

    // With width/flex
    { field: 'description', width: 200 },
    { field: 'notes', flex: 1, minWidth: 150 },

    // Column grouping
    {
        headerName: 'Group',
        children: [
            { field: 'gold' },
            { field: 'silver' }
        ]
    }
];

const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs,
    defaultColDef: {
        sortable: true,
        filter: true,
        resizable: true
    }
};
```

### Column Types

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnTypes: {
        currency: {
            width: 150,
            valueFormatter: params => `$${params.value}`
        },
        numeric: {
            type: 'rightAligned',
            filter: 'agNumberColumnFilter'
        }
    },
    columnDefs: [
        { field: 'price', type: ['currency', 'numeric'] }
    ]
};
```

### Column State

```javascript
// Get column state
const state = api.getColumnState();

// Apply column state
api.applyColumnState({
    state: [{ colId: 'athlete', sort: 'asc', width: 200 }],
    defaultState: { sort: null }
});
```

## Row Models

### Client-Side Row Model (default)
All data loaded into browser. Supports sorting, filtering, grouping locally.

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    rowModelType: 'clientSide', // default
    rowData: dataArray
};
```

### Server-Side Row Model (Enterprise)
Lazy loading with server-side operations. Ideal for large datasets.

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    rowModelType: 'serverSide',
    serverSideDatasource: {
        getRows: (params) => {
            fetch('/api/data', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: JSON.stringify(params.request)
            })
            .then(response => response.json())
            .then(data => params.success({ rowData: data.rows }))
            .catch(() => params.fail());
        }
    },
    cacheBlockSize: 50
};
```

### Infinite Row Model
Lazy loading for large flat datasets. Server handles sorting/filtering.

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    rowModelType: 'infinite',
    datasource: {
        getRows: (params) => {
            // params.startRow, params.endRow, params.sortModel, params.filterModel
            fetchData(params.startRow, params.endRow).then(data => {
                params.success(data.rows, data.lastRow);
            });
        }
    }
};
```

### Viewport Row Model
Server-driven updates for real-time data streams.

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    rowModelType: 'viewport',
    viewportDatasource: myDatasource
};
```

## Row IDs

Critical for maintaining state (selection, grouping) across data updates.

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    getRowId: (params) => params.data.id // Must return unique string
};
```

## Data Updates

### Client-Side Updates

```javascript
// Replace all data
api.setGridOption('rowData', newData);

// Update single row
const rowNode = api.getRowNode('row-id');
rowNode.setDataValue('price', newPrice);
rowNode.setData(newRowData);
rowNode.updateData(partialData);

// Transaction updates (add/remove/update)
api.applyTransaction({
    add: [newRow1, newRow2],
    update: [updatedRow],
    remove: [rowToRemove]
});

// Async transactions for high-frequency updates
api.applyTransactionAsync({ add: [row] }, callback);
api.flushAsyncTransactions();
```

### Server-Side Updates

```javascript
// Refresh data
api.refreshServerSide({ purge: true });

// Transaction updates
api.applyServerSideTransaction({
    update: [{ data: newData, getRowId: () => 'id' }]
});
```

## Row Selection

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    rowSelection: {
        mode: 'singleRow', // or 'multiRow'
        checkboxes: true,
        enableClickSelection: true,
        groupSelects: 'self' // for tree/grouped data
    },
    onSelectionChanged: (event) => {
        const selectedRows = api.getSelectedRows();
        const selectedNodes = api.getSelectedNodes();
    }
};
```

## Sorting

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        { field: 'age', sortable: true, sortingOrder: ['asc', 'desc'] }
    ],
    // Custom comparator
    columnDefs: [
        {
            field: 'name',
            comparator: (a, b) => a.toLowerCase().localeCompare(b.toLowerCase())
        }
    ]
};

// API methods
api.applyColumnState({
    state: [{ colId: 'age', sort: 'asc' }]
});
```

## Filtering

### Column Filters

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        // Text filter (default for strings)
        { field: 'athlete', filter: true },

        // Number filter
        { field: 'age', filter: 'agNumberColumnFilter' },

        // Date filter
        { field: 'date', filter: 'agDateColumnFilter' },

        // Set filter (Enterprise)
        { field: 'country', filter: 'agSetColumnFilter' }
    ]
};
```

### Set Filter (Enterprise)

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        {
            field: 'country',
            filter: 'agSetColumnFilter',
            filterParams: {
                values: ['USA', 'UK', 'Canada'],
                caseSensitive: false,
                treeList: true // for hierarchical values
            }
        }
    ]
};
```

### Quick Filter

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    quickFilterText: 'search text',
    cacheQuickFilter: true,
    quickFilterParser: (text) => text.split(' ')
};
```

### External Filter

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    isExternalFilterPresent: () => externalFilterActive,
    doesExternalFilterPass: (params) => params.data.status === 'active'
};
```

### Filter API

```javascript
// Get/set filter model
const model = api.getFilterModel();
api.setFilterModel(model);

// Individual filter
await api.setColumnFilterModel('country', { values: ['USA'] });
api.onFilterChanged();
```

## Cell Editing

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        // Basic editable
        { field: 'name', editable: true },

        // Conditional editing
        { field: 'age', editable: params => params.data.canEdit },

        // With custom editor
        { field: 'country', cellEditor: 'agRichSelectCellEditor', cellEditorParams: {
            values: ['USA', 'UK']
        }}
    ],
    onCellValueChanged: (event) => console.log('Changed:', event)
};
```

### Provided Editors

- `agTextCellEditor` - Text input (default for strings)
- `agNumberCellEditor` - Numeric input
- `agDateCellEditor` - Date picker
- `agSelectCellEditor` - HTML select
- `agRichSelectCellEditor` (Enterprise) - Enhanced select with search
- `agLargeTextCellEditor` - Multi-line textarea
- `agCheckboxCellEditor` - Checkbox

### Custom Editor

```javascript
class CustomEditor {
    agInit(params) {
        this.params = params;
        // Create DOM element
    }
    getGui() { return this.element; }
    getValue() { return this.currentValue; }
    isPopup() { return false; } // or true for popup
}
```

## Cell Data Types

Automatic type inference for proper rendering, editing, filtering.

Built-in types: `text`, `number`, `bigint`, `boolean`, `date`, `dateString`, `dateTime`, `dateTimeString`, `object`

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        { field: 'price', cellDataType: 'number' },
        { field: 'active', cellDataType: 'boolean' },
        { field: 'created', cellDataType: 'date' }
    ]
};
```

## Cell Styling

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        // Static style
        { field: 'status', cellStyle: { color: 'red' } },

        // Dynamic style
        {
            field: 'value',
            cellStyle: params => {
                if (params.value > 100) return { backgroundColor: 'green' };
                return null;
            }
        },

        // CSS class rules
        {
            field: 'profit',
            cellClassRules: {
                'profit-positive': params => params.value > 0,
                'profit-negative': params => params.value < 0
            }
        }
    ]
};
```

## Custom Components

### Cell Renderer

```javascript
// Function renderer
{ field: 'price', cellRenderer: params => `$${params.value}` }

// Class renderer
class StatusRenderer {
    agInit(params) { this.params = params; }
    getGui() {
        const span = document.createElement('span');
        span.textContent = this.params.value;
        return span;
    }
}
{ field: 'status', cellRenderer: StatusRenderer }

// React inline
{ field: 'name', cellRenderer: params => <b>{params.value}</b> }
```

### Dynamic Renderer Selection

```javascript
{
    field: 'type',
    cellRendererSelector: params => {
        if (params.data.type === 'number') {
            return { component: NumberRenderer, params: {} };
        }
        return { component: TextRenderer };
    }
}
```

## Row Grouping (Enterprise)

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        { field: 'country', rowGroup: true },
        { field: 'sport', rowGroup: true },
        { field: 'gold', aggFunc: 'sum' }
    ],
    groupDisplayType: 'singleColumn', // or 'multipleColumns', 'groupRows'
    // Group panel for drag-and-drop grouping
    rowGroupPanelShow: 'always'
};
```

## Pivoting (Enterprise)

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    pivotMode: true,
    columnDefs: [
        { field: 'country', rowGroup: true },
        { field: 'sport', pivot: true },
        { field: 'gold', aggFunc: 'sum' }
    ],
    pivotRowTotals: 'before'
};
```

## Aggregation (Enterprise)

Built-in functions: `sum`, `min`, `max`, `count`, `avg`, `first`, `last`

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        { field: 'gold', aggFunc: 'sum' },
        { field: 'silver', aggFunc: 'avg' }
    ],
    // Custom aggregation
    aggFuncs: {
        range: params => Math.max(...params.values) - Math.min(...params.values)
    }
};
```

## Tree Data (Enterprise)

```javascript
// Path-based
const gridOptions = {
    treeData: true,
    getDataPath: data => data.path // ['Group', 'SubGroup', 'Item']
};

// Self-referential (most performant)
const gridOptions = {
    treeData: true,
    treeDataParentIdField: 'parentId',
    getRowId: params => params.data.id
};
```

## Master/Detail (Enterprise)

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    masterDetail: true,
    detailCellRendererParams: {
        detailGridOptions: {
            columnDefs: [{ field: 'callId' }]
        },
        getDetailRowData: params => {
            params.successCallback(params.data.callRecords);
        }
    }
};
```

## Pagination

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    pagination: true,
    paginationPageSize: 100,
    paginationAutoPageSize: true, // fit to grid height
    paginationPageSizeSelector: [10, 25, 50, 100]
};
```

## Export

### CSV Export

```javascript
api.exportDataAsCsv({
    columnSeparator: ',',
    fileName: 'data.csv',
    onlySelected: true
});
```

### Excel Export (Enterprise)

```javascript
api.exportDataAsExcel({
    fileName: 'data.xlsx',
    sheetName: 'Sheet1',
    excelStyles: [
        { id: 'header', font: { bold: true } }
    ]
});
```

## Theming

### Built-in Themes

```javascript
import { themeQuartz, themeBalham, themeMaterial, themeAlpine } from 'ag-grid-community';

const gridOptions = {
    theme: themeQuartz
};
```

### Theme Parameters

```javascript
import { themeQuartz } from 'ag-grid-community';

const myTheme = themeQuartz.withParams({
    // Colors
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    foregroundColor: '#000000',
    accentColor: '#2196f3',

    // Spacing
    spacing: 10,

    // Borders
    rowBorder: { style: 'solid', width: 1, color: '#e0e0e0' },

    // Fonts
    fontFamily: 'Roboto',
    fontSize: 14,

    // Header
    headerBackgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
    headerTextColor: '#333',

    // Selection
    selectedRowBackgroundColor: '#e3f2fd'
});

const gridOptions = { theme: myTheme };
```

### Theme Parts

Mix elements from different themes:

```javascript
import { themeQuartz, iconSetMaterial, colorSchemeDark } from 'ag-grid-community';

const myTheme = themeQuartz
    .withPart(iconSetMaterial)
    .withPart(colorSchemeDark)
    .withParams({ accentColor: 'red' });
```

### Dark Mode

```javascript
// CSS-based switching
<body data-ag-theme-mode="dark">

// Or with theme params
const myTheme = themeQuartz
    .withParams({ /* light params */ }, 'light')
    .withParams({ /* dark params */ }, 'dark');
```

## Integrated Charts (Enterprise)

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    enableCharts: true,
    chartThemeOverrides: {
        common: {
            title: { enabled: true }
        }
    }
};

// API: create chart from range
api.createRangeChart({
    chartType: 'line',
    cellRange: { columns: ['country', 'gold'] }
});
```

## Sparklines (Enterprise)

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    columnDefs: [
        {
            field: 'trend',
            cellRenderer: 'agSparklineCellRenderer',
            cellRendererParams: {
                sparklineOptions: {
                    type: 'line',
                    line: { stroke: '#2196f3' }
                }
            }
        }
    ]
};
```

## Tool Panels (Enterprise)

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    sideBar: {
        toolPanels: [
            {
                id: 'columns',
                labelDefault: 'Columns',
                iconKey: 'columns',
                toolPanel: 'agColumnsToolPanel'
            },
            {
                id: 'filters',
                labelDefault: 'Filters',
                iconKey: 'filter',
                toolPanel: 'agFilterToolPanel'
            }
        ],
        defaultToolPanel: 'columns'
    }
};
```

## Keyboard Navigation

Default keyboard shortcuts:
- Arrow keys: Cell navigation
- Tab: Next/previous cell
- Enter/F2: Start editing
- Escape: Cancel editing
- Ctrl+C/V/X: Clipboard operations
- Space: Checkbox toggle
- Home/End: First/last cell

## Grid API Key Methods

```javascript
// Data operations
api.setGridOption('rowData', newData)
api.applyTransaction({ add, update, remove })
api.getSelectedRows()
api.getSelectedNodes()
api.getRowNode(id)

// Column operations
api.getColumnState()
api.applyColumnState({ state })
api.moveColumns(keys, toIndex)
api.autoSizeAllColumns()

// Filter operations
api.getFilterModel()
api.setFilterModel(model)
api.onFilterChanged()

// Export
api.exportDataAsCsv(params)
api.exportDataAsExcel(params) // Enterprise

// Refresh
api.refreshCells({ columns, force })
api.redrawRows({ rowNodes })
api.refreshServerSide({ purge }) // SSRM

// Events
api.addEventListener(eventName, callback)
api.removeEventListener(eventName, callback)

// Grid lifecycle
api.sizeColumnsToFit()
api.destroy()
```

## Key Events

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    // Lifecycle
    onGridReady: (params) => { /* grid initialized */ },
    onFirstDataRendered: (params) => { /* first render */ },

    // Data
    onCellValueChanged: (event) => { /* cell edited */ },
    onRowDataUpdated: (event) => { /* rowData changed */ },

    // Selection
    onSelectionChanged: (event) => { /* selection changed */ },
    onRowSelected: (event) => { /* row selected/deselected */ },

    // Filtering/Sorting
    onFilterChanged: (event) => { /* filter changed */ },
    onSortChanged: (event) => { /* sort changed */ },

    // Cells
    onCellClicked: (event) => { /* cell clicked */ },
    onCellDoubleClicked: (event) => { /* cell double-clicked */ },

    // Rows
    onRowClicked: (event) => { /* row clicked */ },
    onRowDoubleClicked: (event) => { /* row double-clicked */ },

    // Columns
    onColumnMoved: (event) => { /* column moved */ },
    onColumnResized: (event) => { /* column resized */ },

    // Drag
    onRowDragEnter: (event) => { /* drag start */ },
    onRowDragEnd: (event) => { /* drag end */ }
};
```

## React Best Practices

```jsx
// Use hooks for stable references
const [rowData, setRowData] = useState(data);
const [columnDefs, setColumnDefs] = useState(cols);
const defaultColDef = useMemo(() => ({ filter: true }), []);
const isRowSelectable = useCallback((node) => node.data.active, []);

// Use getRowId for state preservation
const getRowId = useCallback((params) => params.data.id, []);

// Debug mode for diagnosing issues
<AgGridReact debug />
```

## Performance Optimization

```javascript
const gridOptions = {
    // Reduce row buffer for large datasets
    rowBuffer: 10,

    // Suppress animations
    animateRows: false,

    // Debounce scroll
    suppressScrollOnNewData: true,

    // Use delta sorting for frequent updates
    columnDefs: [
        { field: 'price', deltaSort: true }
    ],

    // Async transactions
    asyncTransactionWaitMillis: 50
};
```

## Community vs Enterprise

| Feature | Community | Enterprise |
|---------|-----------|------------|
| Basic Grid | ✓ | ✓ |
| Sorting | ✓ | ✓ |
| Filtering (Text, Number, Date) | ✓ | ✓ |
| Editing | ✓ | ✓ |
| Selection | ✓ | ✓ |
| Pagination | ✓ | ✓ |
| Column Pinning | ✓ | ✓ |
| Column Groups | ✓ | ✓ |
| Row Grouping | - | ✓ |
| Pivoting | - | ✓ |
| Aggregation | - | ✓ |
| Tree Data | - | ✓ |
| Master/Detail | - | ✓ |
| Set Filter | - | ✓ |
| Excel Export | - | ✓ |
| Integrated Charts | - | ✓ |
| Sparklines | - | ✓ |
| Clipboard | - | ✓ |
| Range Selection | - | ✓ |
| Undo/Redo | - | ✓ |
| Context Menu | - | ✓ |

## License (Enterprise)

```javascript
import { LicenseManager } from 'ag-grid-enterprise';
LicenseManager.setLicenseKey('your-license-key');
```

Or via environment variable:
```bash
AG_GRID_LICENSE_KEY=your-license-key
```
